results.name: No RPC API keys in network requests
results.summary: None of the 5 recorded requests carries an RPC API key.
results.source: network log (HAR) Kane CLI recorded during the "swap-flow" run
results.fix: Remove provider API keys from frontend code. Use a keyless public RPC for read calls, or route keyed calls through a server-side proxy. Treat any key that was shipped as leaked and rotate it.

kane.remark: assert: no URL in {{page_requests}} contains an RPC provider API key, such as a long key

results.agreement: Kane and DappSentinel both passed it.

results.summary: All 1 scripts came from trusted hosts.
results.source: network log (HAR) Kane CLI recorded during the "swap-flow" run
results.fix: Remove scripts loaded from third-party CDNs, or bundle them with the app. Every script that runs on a dApp page can read and change what the user signs, so drainers are often injected this way.

results.fix: Never store private keys, seed phrases or signing secrets in localStorage or sessionStorage. Any script on the page can read them. Keep only public data, such as the wallet address, and leave signing to the wallet.
